result.title: Every Query Routes Itself: Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers with Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention
result.summary: Self-attention over long token sequences dominates the inference cost of video diffusion transformers. Clustering-based sparse attention clusters both queries and keys and lets all queries in a cluster share one selection of key clusters. We show that this sharing limits accuracy: with key clusters and density fixed, attention grows more accurate as the query clusters are refined, and is most accurate when each query selects on its own, which needs no query clustering at all. We therefore propose Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention (PQRS), a training-free method that clusters only keys, lets each query select its own key clusters, and compensates for the unselected ones with their centroids. Per-query selections leave no query tile with a shared key list, so PQRS traverses key clusters instead of queries, buckets queries with identical selections into dense tasks, and merges their partial results in one pass under a fixed softmax offset carried from the previous denoising step. On four text-to-video and image-to-video models from the Wan and HunyuanVideo families, PQRS is the fastest of all the sparse attention methods we evaluate and the closest to the dense output, reaching $28.9$ dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V and $35.4$ dB on HunyuanVideo at $1.66$--$2.10\times$ end-to-end speedup.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对视频扩散 Transformer 长序列自注意力的推理开销，提出免训练的逐查询路由稀疏注意力 PQRS：只对 key 聚类，每个 query 自行选择 key 簇并以簇质心补偿未选部分，再通过遍历 key 簇、将选择相同的 query 分桶合并来加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「query 间共享 key 选择会限制精度、细化到逐 query 选择更准」的观察，可能为 LVR 中按查询筛选视觉证据与分配注意力计算粒度提供线索，可供核查逐 query 选择对内部状态贡献的影响；但论文本身属视频生成加速，与推理状态生成无直接联系。
